reading.title: Fruits 1: Choosing Fruit at the Market
reading.text: At the market, Maya asks for an apple, a banana and an orange. She tastes one grape before buying a bunch. A strawberry and a blueberry are on a sample plate beside a raspberry, a blackberry and a gooseberry. She chooses a watermelon, pineapple and mango to share. A peach and pear are for later, and she buys cranberry sauce in a sealed jar.
reading.imageBrief: Produce stall with separate apples, bananas, oranges, grapes, watermelon, pineapple, mango, peaches, pears and berry boxes. Keep species distinct; no readable labels.

reading.title: Fruits 2: Choosing Fruit at the Market
reading.text: A fruit seller shows Maya a papaya and coconut. She buys guava and lychee, then asks about passion fruit. Rambutan has a hairy outer skin; dragon fruit has bright skin and white or red flesh with small seeds. Star fruit is beside a large jackfruit and durian.
